disagreements.why: In the emotional-reliance section this most plausibly names the assistant supporting the user's connection (to others / the real world) as a supportive response act, not the assistant itself engaging in a romantic/relationship dynamic; its sibling engage_in_relationship on the same node already carries the relationship-engagement reading.
Focusing a reply on practical, actionable steps is a content/manner-shaping choice about the response, not adopting or optimizing a goal of the assistant's own.

In the agentic-scope section (l461_608) minimizing external impacts is about how the assistant's tool actions affect the world outside the conversation; the act's whole subject matter is external side-effects, so act_in_world is the closer parent.
